```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- Top-level comment testing parser states -->
  <ns2:child id="c1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags>, &entities;, and <!-- comments -->
    ]]>
  </ns2:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (#PCDATA | item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent_param 'parameter text'>">
  %param;
  <!ENTITY ent_gen "General Entity">
]>
<?pi-target processing instruction data with &ent_gen;?>
<doc xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:ns="http://example.org/ns">
  <!-- Comment 1 -->
  <item ns:attr="value">
    <![CDATA[Unparsed CDATA content with <markup> and &ent_gen;]]>
  </item>
  <item>&ent_param; and &ent_gen;</item>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, desc)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT desc (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY epub "Electronic Publication">
  <!ENTITY % local_dcl "<!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %local_dcl;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.com/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Catalog description comment -->
  <book xlink:type="simple">
    <title>XML Parsing &epub;</title>
    <desc>
      <![CDATA[
        Detailed book description inside CDATA.
        Contains unescaped <, >, and &.
      ]]>
    </desc>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file)*>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!-- Parameter entity comment -->">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY main_ent "Archive Header">
]>
<?xml-log level="debug" mode="verbose"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:meta="http://example.org/meta">
  <!-- Archive root element comment -->
  <meta:info>
    <![CDATA[
      Meta information block:
      <version>1.0</version>
      &main_ent;
    ]]>
  </meta:info>
  <file>&main_ent;</file>
</archive>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY stock "In Stock">
  <!ENTITY status "&stock; - Ready">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY brochure SYSTEM "brochure.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?target-pi data="test"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:local="http://inventory.org/local">
  <!-- Inventory tracking comment -->
  <local:item id="i1">
    <![CDATA[
      Special instructions:
      1. Handle with care.
      2. Status: &status;
    ]]>
  </local:item>
  <item>&status;</item>
</inventory>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE system [
  <!ELEMENT system (node)*>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseNode">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base;Derived">
  <!ENTITY % dtd_macro "<!ENTITY macro_ent 'Macro Expanded'>">
  %dtd_macro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="style.css"?>
<system xmlns="http://system.org/schema" xmlns:cfg="http://system.org/config">
  <!-- Configuration nodes comment -->
  <cfg:node name="primary">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw configuration stream:
      <config>
        <setting>&macro_ent;</setting>
      </config>
    ]]>
  </cfg:node>
  <node>&derived;</node>
</system>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY rec_type "Standard Record">
  <!ENTITY % ext_decl "<!ENTITY rec_ext 'Extended Record'>">
  %ext_decl;
]>
<?db-control action="init" cache="true"?>
<database xmlns="http://db.org/ns" xmlns:db="http://db.org/ns/ext">
  <!-- Database record container comment -->
  <db:record id="rec-01">
    <![CDATA[
      Binary-like stream payload:
      <blob>00FF0A</blob>
      &rec_ext;
    ]]>
  </db:record>
  <record>&rec_type; and &rec_ext;</record>
</database>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE project [
  <!ELEMENT project (module)*>
  <!ELEMENT module (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY mod_name "Core Module">
  <!ENTITY % p_entity "<!ENTITY mod_version 'v2.4'>">
  %p_entity;
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme SYSTEM "readme.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-space preserve?>
<project xmlns="http://project.org/ns" xmlns:dev="http://project.org/dev">
  <!-- Project structure comment -->
  <dev:module status="active">
    <![CDATA[
      Module specification:
      Name: &mod_name;
      Version: &mod_version;
    ]]>
  </dev:module>
  <module>&mod_name; (&mod_version;)</module>
</project>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE report [
  <!ELEMENT report (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY title_prefix "Report: ">
  <!ENTITY full_title "&title_prefix;Annual Summary">
  <!ENTITY % decl "<!ENTITY confidential 'RESTRICTED'>">
  %decl;
]>
<?report-meta author="System" date="2023-10-01"?>
<report xmlns="http://report.org/ns" xmlns:sec="http://report.org/sec">
  <!-- Security classification comment -->
  <sec:section level="1">
    <![CDATA[
      Classification: &confidential;
      Content includes <xml> tags and entities.
    ]]>
  </sec:section>
  <section>&full_title; - &confidential;</section>
</report>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE container [
  <!ELEMENT container (element)*>
  <!ELEMENT element (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY default_val "DefaultValue">
  <!ENTITY % param_block "<!ENTITY nested_val 'NestedEntityValue'>">
  %param_block;
  <!NOTATION html-notation SYSTEM "text/html">
  <!ENTITY external_doc SYSTEM "doc.html" NDATA html-notation>
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction test="true"?>
<container xmlns="http://container.org/ns" xmlns:sub="http://container.org/sub">
  <!-- Container validation comment -->
  <sub:element id="el-1">
    <![CDATA[
      Nested payload block:
      <inner>&nested_val;</inner>
    ]]>
  </sub:element>
  <element>&default_val; and &nested_val;</element>
</container>
